name: Takara Sushi (Logan, UT) Philadelphia Roll (Smoked Salmon & Cream Cheese)
whyItWorks: Smoked salmon and smooth cream cheese provide mild, comforting protein and fat inside tender sushi rice. Ask for peeled cucumber or sub avocado for zero seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Philadelphia Roll with avocado instead of cucumber matchsticks for softer texture.
